rows.en: (School's finally out... I'm starving...)
Luca, let's stop somewhere on the way home.
Where should we go?
How about curry?

Curry, huh...
I'm fine with it as long as it isn't spicy...
So you can't handle spicy food, huh.

(Just like he looks, or...
how should I put it...)
Aren't you kind of smirking?
N-No, I'm noooot?
rows.notes: The Japanese writes 'nai yo' in katakana for a stiff, obviously fake denial.

rows.en:
...Forget it. I'm going home.
Go eat curry by yourself.
Ah, wait up, Lucaaa!
(Did I tease him a little too much?)

(School's finally out...
I'm kinda hungry~)
Luca-kun, let's stop somewhere on the way home.

How about a Chili-Chili Dog?
It's nice and spicy and delicious!
rows.notes: chirichiri doggu: shortened form of the Super Chili-Chili Dog.

rows.en:
A chili dog...?
I'm fine with it as long as it isn't spicy...
Like THAT'S gonna happen!

...Forget it. I'm going home.
Go eat a chili dog by yourself.
Ah, wait up, Luca-kuuun!
rows.notes: Name plate in the data says Luca, but this is the female player calling after Luca (twin of male c17749). Translated as the player's line.

rows.en: (Did I tease him a little too much?)

(I went to the bathroom,
and now I'm running late...!)
Whoa!
rows.notes: Shared by Luca, Pinon and the player (scd_ciz_802).

rows.en: S-Sorry, Luca.
No, I wasn't watching where I was going either...
Can you get up?

Y-Yes!
Thank you...
You didn't hit anything, did you?
W-Well then, I'll be going.
Oh, uh, sure...
(Why was Luca so embarrassed...?)

(A teacher called me over,
and now I'm running late...!)
Eek!
S-Sorry, Luca-kun.
Can you get up?
You didn't hit anything, did you?

(...I was the one who knocked HIM over...
That's kind of a shock...)

(Phew, I flew really well
in EX-Gear training today.)

\p-san,
you're pretty good.

R-Really?
Hearing that from you gives me confidence, Luca.
If you'd like, shall we fly one more time?

I'm fine, but don't you need
to do maintenance on Samson?
It'll double as a durability test for the parts.
(Is that really okay...?)
Is something wrong?
A-Anyway, let's go!
(...I want to get better and better.)

(Phew, I flew really well
in EX-Gear training today.)

R-Really?
Hearing that from you gives me confidence,
Luca-kun.

I'm fine, but don't you need
to do maintenance on Samson?
(Is that really okay...?)
(...What should I do this weekend...)

\p-san,
you look tired.

Not really.
I was just thinking it's been a long week.
It's the weekend, so let's perk up!
...Are you doing anything this weekend, Luca?

I'm thinking I might do some
adjustments on my EX-Gear.
Huh~ I see.
rows.notes: Shared by eight scenes (Luca, Michel, Ranka, Yui), both genders; neutral.

rows.en:
I want to go buy parts today,
so if you'll excuse me.

Not really?
I was just thinking it's been a long week~
rows.notes: Name plate data says Luca (male scene), but the line is the female player's twin of c17791 (one occurrence is labelled PLAYER, female). Translated as the player's reply to Luca.

rows.en: (Luca really loves machines, huh.)

Hey, Luca-kun,
do you have any plans this weekend?
(Luca-kun really loves machines, huh.)

uncertain: c17757: speaker data says Luca, but it is the female player's 'wait up, Luca-kun' (twin of c17749); translated as the player.
c17797: speaker data says Luca (x3, one occurrence PLAYER female); it is the female player's twin of c17791 ('a long week'); translated as the player.
c17755: 'sonna wake nai jaan' after Luca hopes it isn't spicy: read as the player teasing that of course it is ('Like THAT'S gonna happen!').
c17745: mikake doori to iu ka: the player thinks Luca's dislike of spicy food matches his (boyish) looks; kept as 'Just like he looks'.
